about_the_game:
Step into the boots of a daring 19th-century explorer and journey to The Lost World — a prehistoric plateau hidden beyond the mists of civilization. Inspired by the classic novel by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, this immersive VR experience plunges you into a realm where ancient beasts roam free and survival is anything but guaranteed.

As a member of an elite scientific expedition, you'll face more than just the unknown: you'll confront tooth and claw, unravel long-buried mysteries, and make impossible choices between discovery and self-preservation. Every trek into the jungle could be your last.

No modern weapons. No second chances. Only your skill, your nerve, and your knowledge of the natural world.

Key Features:

  • 🦖 True-to-life Dinosaur Encounters: Stalk and study creatures brought to life with realistic behavior and sound.

  • 🔬 Exploration Meets Survival: Traverse treacherous terrain, decipher ancient markings, and uncover hidden truths.

  • 🎩 Victorian Expedition Gear: Use era-authentic tools, from single-shot rifles to field journals and specimen kits.

  • 🌿 Immersive VR Design: Interact with your surroundings naturally — climb, track, aim, and survive using your own movements.

  • 🌋 Dynamic Environments: Weather, time of day, and ecosystem behaviors evolve with your choices and progress.

Do you seek glory, science, or survival? In The Lost World, only one may be possible.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (only 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / i3-12100 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 / AMD RX Vega 64 (8 ГБ VRAM)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (only 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / i3-12100 orAMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon 5700 XT
